name: Bachelor of Laws
about: A four-year law degree from the Faculty of Law, which sits in Wellington's parliamentary precinct. First-year law courses are open to everyone with University Entrance; entry to second-year Law is limited and ranked on first-year grades.

name: Political Science and International Relations
about: Study how power and resources are distributed and how political decisions shape societies, in New Zealand's capital. Political Science here came first in the country, and it is the only undergraduate International Relations degree.

name: Bachelor of Computer Science
about: Computer science at Waikato covers a flexible major with research in areas such as machine learning, cyber security, human-computer interaction and software engineering, taught in Hamilton and Tauranga.

name: Bachelor of Laws
about: The four-year professional law degree, studied in Hamilton, Tauranga or online, with the option of a Diploma in Law or a BA in Law whose papers can be credited towards the LLB.
